description: Provision a Google Cloud Bigquery BigQueryRoutine via Config Connector. Fields mirror the bigquery.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 BigQueryRoutine spec.

arguments.description: Input/output argument of a function or a stored procedure.

argumentKind.description: Defaults to FIXED_TYPE. Default value: "FIXED_TYPE" Possible values: ["FIXED_TYPE", "ANY_TYPE"].

dataType.description:
A JSON schema for the data type. Required unless argumentKind = ANY_TYPE.
~>**NOTE**: Because this field expects a JSON string, any changes to the string
will create a diff, even if the JSON itself hasn't changed. If the API returns
a different value for the same schema, e.g. it switched the order of values
or replaced STRUCT field type with RECORD field type, we currently cannot
suppress the recurring diff this causes. As a workaround, we recommend using
the schema as returned by the API.

mode.description: Specifies whether the argument is input or output. Can be set for procedures only. Possible values: ["IN", "OUT", "INOUT"].

name.description: The name of this argument. Can be absent for function return argument.

datasetRef.description: The ID of the dataset containing this routine. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `BigQueryDataset` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

definitionBody.description:
The body of the routine. For functions, this is the expression in the AS clause.
If language=SQL, it is the substring inside (but excluding) the parentheses.

description.description: The description of the routine if defined.

determinismLevel.description: The determinism level of the JavaScript UDF if defined. Possible values: ["DETERMINISM_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED", "DETERMINISTIC", "NOT_DETERMINISTIC"].

importedLibraries.description:
Optional. If language = "JAVASCRIPT", this field stores the path of the
imported JAVASCRIPT libraries.

language.description: The language of the routine. Possible values: ["SQL", "JAVASCRIPT"].

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The routineId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

returnTableType.description:
Optional. Can be set only if routineType = "TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION".

If absent, the return table type is inferred from definitionBody at query time in each query
that references this routine. If present, then the columns in the evaluated table result will
be cast to match the column types specificed in return table type, at query time.

returnType.description:
A JSON schema for the return type. Optional if language = "SQL"; required otherwise.
If absent, the return type is inferred from definitionBody at query time in each query
that references this routine. If present, then the evaluated result will be cast to
the specified returned type at query time. ~>**NOTE**: Because this field expects a JSON
string, any changes to the string will create a diff, even if the JSON itself hasn't
changed. If the API returns a different value for the same schema, e.g. it switche
d the order of values or replaced STRUCT field type with RECORD field type, we currently
cannot suppress the recurring diff this causes. As a workaround, we recommend using
the schema as returned by the API.

routineType.description: Immutable. The type of routine. Possible values: ["SCALAR_FUNCTION", "PROCEDURE", "TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION"].

title: GCP Bigquery BigQueryRoutine
